## Features
- A giant inflatable Snowman
- Illuminated by LED lights
- Indoor or outdoor use
- Long lead and ground support pegs
- With a built-in fan for inflation and easy set-up

## Information
Light up your outdoor space this Christmas time with this Giant inflatable Snowman. The inflatable Snowman is suitable to be placed anywhere in your outdoor space whether you choose to show him off in a grand display on your driveway or in a backyard display. This inflatable Snowman is sure to bring the magical feeling of Christmas to your home. The Snowman is illuminated by low-powered LEDs, that last up to 500 times longer than a standard bulb, and he is wearing a top hat and matching gloves with a stripy scarf. The inanimate Snowman has a raised right arm to give the appearance he is waving ready to welcome any visitors into your home. Easy to set up, just plug in and watch the Snowman inflate and just unplug to deflate him. An electric fan, Ground pegs and guy ropes are included, however, we recommend adding extra weight to the base (inside the feet) such as a sandbag to make this more secure. We would also recommend tying the item down to a fixed point rather than using the pegs provided. Suitable for outdoor use and a long lead cable from product to plug, the transformer must be located indoors.
